saints.name: St. Onesimus
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The runaway slave of Philemon whom St. Paul begot in his chains and sent back as “no longer a slave, but a brother”…
biography: Onesimus was a slave of Philemon of Colossae who ran away to Rome, where he met the imprisoned St. Paul and was converted. Paul sent him back to his master with the tender letter that bears Philemon’s name, pleading that he be received “no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a brother beloved.”
Ancient tradition holds that Onesimus was freed, served the Church, and became a bishop, dying at last a martyr. He is commemorated in the Roman Martyrology on this day.
saints.knownFor: The convert-slave of the Epistle to Philemon.

sources.text: The Roman Martyrology (1914 English ed.; public domain), 16 February
